one_liner: Ranks every number by its chance of returning now under its own mix of four return patterns, fitted to all its gaps.
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_18 looks at how long each number has been away since it was last drawn. It describes each number's gaps between appearances (all its gaps) as a mix of four fixed patterns: quick returns, fair returns, long absences and evenly spaced returns, fitted exactly and pulled towards the fair pattern by 10 fair gaps. Each number scores its chance of returning now under its mix. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 104 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
